name: sherz-apps
description: SHERZ desktop (Electron) and mobile (Capacitor) apps. They bundle the web app from ../public.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix desktop && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run sync && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run sync && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.mobile:init: npm run sync && npm run init --prefix mobile
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run sync && npm run sync --prefix mobile
scripts.android:open: npm run mobile:sync && npm run open:android --prefix mobile
scripts.android:apk: npm run mobile:sync && npm run apk --prefix mobile
scripts.ios:open: npm run mobile:sync && npm run open:ios --prefix mobile
